subject: Master's degree
hook: MASTER'S DEGREE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The Master's degree was originally a license to teach rather than a mark of advanced academic achievement, and in many prestigious universities, it was historically awarded automatically to graduates after a few years without any further study or examination.
angle_support: The original meaning of the master's degree was thus that someone who had been admitted to the rank (degree) of master (i.e. teacher) in one university should be admitted to the same rank in other universities.

In Oxford, Cambridge, and Trinity College Dublin, the MA was awarded to BA graduates of a certain standing without further examination from the late 17th century, its main purpose being to confer full membership of the university.
title: The Master’s Degree Was Once a Teaching Licence, Not a Test
description: Most people think a master's proves extra study. In fact, it started as a licence to teach and many elite universities granted it automatically years after a bachelor's, with no exam.
narration: MASTER'S DEGREE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a master's as coursework expertise. It began as a licence to teach and at Oxford and Cambridge was awarded automatically after a BA, without study. A 1233 papal bull said any master could teach at university. From the 1600s Oxford and Cambridge granted the MA to BA graduates, no exam, and the 1835 rule awarded it three years after the BA. So the master's was once a teaching licence, not a test
